Our recommendation

Move to Iceland… with a plan.

Iceland is much more expensive than Mexico, but people earn significantly more, so the standard of living is higher. The main reason is simple: it is the safest country in the world.

✔ Why yes

Higher income, free public healthcare, clean air and the best safety in the world.

✘ Be careful

Rent and food cost a lot more, winters are long, dark and much colder, and you will miss Mexican food and family.

★ Best for

People with a job offer who can afford the first months and love nature more than sunny beaches.
